summary: Added docshelf/access.py (Rules, role, suspended, is_admin, acting_for, can_read/write/share/delete) and moved every access check out of listing, show, edit, share, delete and audit, each now with its own RULES; added tests/test_access.py. All 30 tests pass, and a differential fuzz against the original package (36,000 CLI runs, comparing stdout, stderr, exit status and workspace files) gave identical results. The disagreements between the old copies are kept as they were, not fixed.
